name: Microsoft Graph Enterprise / Entra Identity
description: Investigate Microsoft Entra identity and enterprise Microsoft Graph context through Microsoft's hosted MCP server

contributions.name: Microsoft Graph Enterprise / Entra Identity
contributions.description: Suggest and execute read-only Microsoft Graph queries for enterprise identity context
contributions.instructions: Register a least-privilege Entra OAuth application with TurenOS's loopback redirect. Use delegated read scopes only and do not permit Graph write, directory administration, or consent-management operations.
